name: dprint
description: dprint — pluggable code formatter. Format TypeScript, JSON, Markdown, TOML, Rust, and more. Fast, WASM-based plugins.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/dprint/dprint/releases/download/0.49.1/dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip && unzip -o dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip && sudo mv dprint /usr/local/bin/ && rm dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.
